title: Svalbard Satellite Station 2015-03-23 01.jpg
description: View across the windswept and snow covered Platåberget mountain of  8 of the 46 radars currently deployed by Svalbard Satellite Station (SvalSat). In 2015 they plan to add another four radars, to cater for even more satellites, and with so much space they can easily deploy many more in the years to come.
